cases.name: Rosa Diaz-Santos
cases.about: She was a 9th-grade student at Eleanor Roosevelt High School. Her Go Fund Me said, "Rosa was loved by everyone that met her and she has left a huge empty hole in all her family and friends lives."
cases.narrative: On 11/15/2022, her skeletal remains were found behind some homes on Drexel Street in the town of Takoma Park, MD.
